title: ML Engineer - Intern
description: We are looking for a curious and driven ML Engineering Intern to support our AI team in building, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models and data pipelines.
responsibilities: Assist in preprocessing, cleaning, and analyzing datasets for model training and evaluation.
Support the development and fine-tuning of ML models under the guidance of senior engineers.
Document experiments, results, and model performance metrics for internal knowledge sharing.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML solutions into production workflows.
requirements: Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
Familiarity with Python and ML libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Basic understanding of data structures, algorithms, and statistical concepts.
Strong willingness to learn, problem-solve, and contribute in a fast-paced environment.

title: Backend Engineer - Intern (Python / FastAPI / Django REST)
description: Join our backend team as an intern to help build scalable REST APIs, server-side logic, and database architectures using Python, FastAPI, and Django REST Framework.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services using FastAPI and Django REST Framework.
Design and optimize database schemas using PostgreSQL and work with ORMs like SQLAlchemy or Django ORM.
Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews with senior engineers.
Debug, document, and improve existing backend systems and microservices.
requirements: Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Solid understanding of Python and hands-on experience with FastAPI or Django REST Framework.
Basic knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL / MySQL) and REST API design principles.
Familiarity with Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines is a plus.

title: Mobile App Developer - Intern (Flutter)
description: We are seeking a passionate Mobile App Developer Intern to build beautiful, performant cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
Implement responsive UI components and ensure smooth user experiences across iOS and Android.
Integrate REST APIs, manage local state, and handle asynchronous data flows.
Write unit and widget tests, debug issues, and optimize app performance.
requirements: Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Mobile Development, or a related field.
Hands-on experience with Flutter, Dart, and state management solutions (Provider, Riverpod, Bloc).
Understanding of mobile UI/UX principles and platform-specific design guidelines.
Familiarity with Firebase, REST APIs, and version control (Git) is a plus.

title: Digital Marketing - Intern
description: We are looking for a creative and analytical Digital Marketing Intern to support our growth team in executing campaigns, managing social media, and analyzing performance metrics.
responsibilities: Assist in planning and executing digital marketing campaigns across social media, email, and paid channels.
Create engaging content for blogs, social posts, newsletters, and landing pages.
Monitor, analyze, and report on campaign performance using tools like Google Analytics and Meta Business Suite.
Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify growth opportunities.
requirements: Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
Familiarity with social media platforms, content creation tools, and basic SEO/SEM concepts.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with an eye for detail.
Experience with Canva, Figma, or analytics tools is a plus.
